claims.claim: In the committed 7-day backtest, 13 of the 20 recommended repositories had gained at least 10% more stars since the day they were recommended.
claims.metric: share of recommended repositories whose star count grew by at least 10% within the 7-day backtest window, at a score threshold of 90
claims.method: scripts/verify_scoring.py reads the committed daily reports in data/discovery-*.json, takes stars_at_discovery from them, compares against the repository's current star count, and counts a repository as taking off at growth_rate >= 0.1

claims.claim: Recommended repositories in that same 7-day window grew 18.71% on average, or 309 stars per day.
claims.metric: mean star growth rate and mean absolute daily star growth across the 20 repositories in the backtest window
claims.method: same run as backtest-precision-7d; reported as avg_growth_rate_all and avg_daily_growth in the metrics block of the report

claims.claim: The recall and lift figures in that backtest report are not usable as evidence, because every repository in the sample scored at or above the threshold.
claims.metric: size of the below-threshold comparison group in the backtest sample
claims.method: the report's own metrics block records high_score_count 20 and low_score_count 0, so recall 1.0 and lift "inf" are arithmetic artifacts of an empty comparison group rather than measurements of discrimination
